snapshot.text: Post-conflict health system rebuilding under a transitional government. Care relies heavily on out-of-pocket payments, and up to 70% of health workers have left the country. The National Health Strategy 2026–2028 aims to move the sector from emergency response to recovery.

priorities.title: National Health Strategy 2026–2028
priorities.text: Plan to restore health facilities, retain the health workforce, and strengthen health security, with medicines and supplies prioritised. Launched in December.

priorities.title: Family health model pilot
priorities.text: Pilot of a family health model at 40 centres, under the 2026–2028 plan, to be tested and evaluated before wider rollout.

priorities.title: Pharmaceutical regulation overhaul
priorities.text: Roadmap to modernise medicine regulation, developed with WHO, UNDP and partners to improve medicine quality, safety and oversight.

netherlands.text: The Dutch foreign trade minister says Dutch support for Syria centres on humanitarian aid, reconstruction and conditions for safe refugee return. Health is not named specifically in this statement.
